fields.fieldText:
AEP Consulting 

CX Strategy Assessment & Optimization—Provides expert guidance to optimize customer experience management strategy and contact center operations.


Experience Engineering, Journey Mapping—Provides a detailed map of the customer's experience with the brand, highlighting opportunities to improve the customer experience and drive satisfaction. 


AR/VR Advisory, Optimization—Leveraging Alorica's resident expertise to evaluate and optimize an AR/VR strategy in alignment with aspirations and outcomes.


Automated Discovery—A method to capture and analyze the "Voice of the Process" from an agent perspective to identify drivers of pain points and possible transformational interventions to address them.



AI/ML & Automation

Knowledge Management—An end-to-end solution (i.e., evaluating, designing, deploying, maintaining a client's knowledge management solution) or part thereof.


Self-service, Deflection—A solution that aims to "eliminate" the need for a customer service agent to provide resolution.


Agent-Assist—Provide agents assistance through technologies that help retrieve information from multiple systems and enable efficient execution of repeatable tasks.


Next Best Action—Provide agents assistance through technologies a recommended next step to effectively probe, diagnose and/or address the caller's needs.


Virtual agents - Voice & Digital—A virtual digital agent replacing a human agent fully or partly, and uses synchronous or asynchronous responses, or part thereof.


Intelligent Automation—Human actions can be automated resulting in complete or a partial elimination of human effort.



AI Enabled Analytics

Automated QA—Leveraging speech analytics software to manage quality at scale, and enable automated quality assurance analysis for 100% of voice and text interactions with fast and accurate results.


Intelligent Reporting—Utilize BI tools and automation to prepare, analyze, and visualize data to find actionable insights thus helping users improve decisions and business performance.


Insights analysis - Process, Agent, Customer Analytics—Deployment of analysis on Structured and Unstructured Data (voice, chats, emails) to discover patterns, trends, and gain a deeper understanding of the process, agent and customer behavior to generate actionable insights


Emotion/Sentiment/Intent Analysis—Use of Natural Language Processing tools on speech/text data to identify the emotional tone of the interaction. Used mainly to understand customer pain points, intensity of the issue and categorize opinions on product, service or ideas expressed.


Customer Journey Analytics—Use of a combination of structured and unstructured data (using speech and tech analytics) to understand end-to-end customer experience. From the need to contact across multiple touch points, channels, and processes to fulfillment of resolution and service provided. A wholistic view of the experience thus highlighting gaps, redundant process, and non-value adds that impact customer experience and business performance.


Social Media Analysis—Analyzing trends and patterns, reporting and gathering meaningful information of the voice of the customer across social platforms. 


Predictive Analytics—Use of advanced analytics – data science, machine learning, AI to study historical data and predict future outcomes impacting business performance, revenue, and customer experience.



"On the Horizon" Incubation Factory

AR / VR factory—Solutions that involve creating and deploying augmented or virtual reality solutions.


Generative AI—Solutions that involve Bard, Open AI, etc.



CCaaS

CCaaS—An integrated, Alorica-managed and cloud hosted omnichannel solution infused with AI/ML, analytics and automation.
